exposure: Fetal growth restriction (FGR) vs. non-FGR fetuses with cCMV
outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of fetal ultrasound for cCMV-associated abnormalities
cohort: 18 fetuses prenatally diagnosed with cCMV (8 with FGR and 10 without FGR)
finding: The diagnostic sensitivity of fetal ultrasound for hepatomegaly and ventriculomegaly was lower in fetuses with cCMV and FGR compared to fetuses with cCMV but without FGR.
followup_time: Not specified, but mentions long-term sequelae
